identity.name: Aman Sachan
identity.tagline: Independent Systems Researcher & Data Strategist. Edge AI, MoE Pruning, C++ Engines, and Econometric Decision Systems.

bio: Independent systems researcher and BBA (Business Analytics) scholar at IIFT Kakinada (2026-2029), working at the intersection of edge AI, model compression, local inference infrastructure, and quantitative business strategy.

Creator of MAPLE (Manifold-Activated Pruning of Latent Experts), compressing Gemma 4 26B from 9.92 GB to 4.75 GB (1.48 BPW) for 100% in-VRAM execution on 6GB laptop GPUs at 45.4 tok/s. Upstream contributor to tensorflow/tensorflow and microsoft/vscode.
extra: Outside systems engineering, I serve as Junior Consultant at 180 Degrees Consulting (IIFT Kakinada), lead an independent robotics team across 20+ hackathons (IIT Bombay Techfest Runner-up, IIT Kanpur Techkriti 2nd Runner-up, ISRO Antariksh Top-50), and compete in national B-school case finals (IIM Bangalore, IIM Indore, IIT Delhi).
Endurance runner (Daudo Bharat 10km Semi-Marathon Silver Medalist, 52 mins), high-altitude trekker, and 17x MUNer (8 Best Delegate awards).

highlights: Conducting structured consulting engagements focused on operational diagnostics, market feasibility, and business unit economics.
Writing custom Python scripts to scrape market data, clean datasets, and accelerate client research workflows.
Built Python prototypes to automatically scale question difficulty and process content, reducing manual task time by 40%.
Maintained partner outreach tracking sheets and milestone trackers across institutional collaborations.
Managed project turnaround schedules and delivery checks across 14 international video editing deliverables with a team of 4.
Led team across 20+ hackathons; managed parts inventory, component costs, and hardware builds (6x6 ground rover, document scanner).
IIT Bombay Techfest Runner-up, IIT Kanpur Techkriti 2nd Runner-up, IIM Indore Epinoia Finalist, ISRO Bharatiya Antariksh Top-50.
Manage travel schedules, vendor bus booking, and seat allocation for 60+ batch students across institutional visits.
Head Boy (2025-26): Managed prefect council, school assemblies, and student-faculty communication.
House Captain (2024-25): Led house of 150+ students across sports and inter-school academic competitions.
